To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

anticipatory mobile networking can be achieved by leveraging the following: 1) context-based classification of the user’s activity; 2) context-based prediction methodologies; 3) optimization techniques.

the main prediction techniques adopted by anticipatory mobile networking are machine learning and time-series analysis, while the main optimization tools are queueing theory, Markov Decision Process and Reinforcement Learning.

anticipatory mobile networking is an emerging research area with a strong focus on context-based prediction and optimization techniques, with the goal of improving network performance and reducing energy consumption.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of anticipatory network technologies that will be capable of predicting the behavior of the network in the near future and of adapting to the predicted conditions in order to improve performance.
the design of novel network architectures and protocols that are able to anticipate the evolution of the network conditions and to adapt to the changes accordingly.
the design of anticipatory networking systems, i.e., networks that leverage context information and prediction techniques to improve network performance and provide a seamless user experience.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, in order to be effective, anticipatory networking should be able to: (i) identify, in real-time, the most relevant contexts for a given network and application, and (ii) use these contexts to predict the future evolution of the network conditions, and, in turn to optimize network performance, while taking into account the constraints and objectives of the specific application and network.
the anticipatory networking is an important research direction that has the potential to improve the quality of service and user experience of next generation networks and applications.
the anticipatory networking is a new and promising paradigm that is expected to play an important role in the evolution of next generation communication networks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have surveyed the state of the art on anticipatory networking and we have provided a classification of the main approaches, tools, objectives and scenarios.
anticipatory networking is a novel approach that leverages context information and machine learning techniques to improve network performance by predicting network conditions.

we have identified a large set of papers in the area of anticipatory networking and we have analyzed them from a common perspective, which allows us to draw a comprehensive picture of the state of the art.
The main takeaway from our work is that
anticipatory networking is a very promising paradigm to improve the performance of next generation networks and to enable new applications.
anticipatory networking is not a single technology, but rather a set of tools and techniques that can be used for different purposes and applications.

the current literature on anticipatory mobile networking is fragmented and lacks a systematic classification of the main techniques used to forecast the future and to leverage this knowledge in the optimization of the network performance.
